# Iron Custom Motors

> Premium motorcycle service in Cascais. Diagnostics, maintenance, repair, spare parts, consumables, upgrades, tuning, and custom motorcycle projects. Service in English, Russian, Ukrainian, Portuguese.

Iron Custom Motors is a premium motorcycle workshop serving Cascais and Greater Lisbon. It provides maintenance and repair, parts sourcing, upgrades, inspections and custom engineering.

## Custom projects portfolio

- [Custom motorcycles we built.](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/): Portfolio of Iron Custom Motors custom builds: AMD World Championship winners, BMW Motorrad 2023 Champion, Bonneville record holders and bespoke projects.
- [Inspirium](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/inspirium/): ICM Inspirium — world speed record motorcycle by Iron Custom Motors at Bonneville Speed Week, class 350APS-VG, vintage 1953 IZH-49 base.
- [Beckman](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/beckman/): ICM Beckman — world champion café racer by Iron Custom Motors, AMD World Championship 2016 winner with hand-built three-cylinder engine.
- [Unbreakable](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/unbreakable/): ICM Unbreakable — BMW Motorrad Customizing Championship winner by Iron Custom Motors. Exhibited at BMW Motorrad Welt.
- [Quanta R](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/quanta-r/): ICM Quanta R — concept project by Iron Custom Motors for Geneva Motor Show and Goodwood. AWD, 2.5L turbo, up to 600 hp, handmade aluminum body.
- [Burly](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/burly/): ICM Burly — BMW R 18 custom dragster by Iron Custom Motors. Foundation for a full line of custom parts and kits for the R 18.
- [Sturmvogel](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/sturmvogel/): ICM Sturmvogel — 2nd place Café Racer at Ericeira Kustom Fest 2026, a dieselpunk custom motorcycle by Iron Custom Motors with AMD and Italian Championship history.
- [Geometric](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/geometric/): ICM Geometric — retro-futurist custom by Iron Custom Motors. AMD World Championship 2018, world's first spoked hubless front wheel.
- [Joker](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/joker/): ICM Joker — custom Harley-Davidson Dyna Street Bob by Iron Custom Motors. Bold urban stance, premium components, nine-color pop-art paint.
- [Hell Boy](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/hellboy/): ICM Hell Boy — Best Paint winner at Ericeira Kustom Fest 2026, a custom trike by Iron Custom Motors with comic-art airbrush, chrome skull mascot and 360-section rear tire.
- [True Religion](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/true-religion/): ICM True Religion — custom motorcycle by Iron Custom Motors inspired by denim culture, Harley-Davidson heritage and the open-road spirit.
- [Fighter](https://ironcustommotors.com/projects/fighter/): A 2.90 m long chopper with a RevTech 110" engine and a real passenger seat. The story of Fighter, a full custom built by Iron Custom Motors in 2014.
